saveTplzh.text:
这一步怎么来、怎么走

1. 从哪里打开：在某个项目上点“更多”（资源库每行末尾的三个点，或工作区右上角），选“另存为模板…”。

2. 弹出这个窗口，背后是你正在看的那个项目。填模板名称和说明，勾选要放进模板的文件。依赖、构建产物和可能含密钥的文件默认不勾。

3. 点“保存模板”后窗口关闭，回到原来的项目，底部提示“已保存为模板”。

4. 以后新建项目时，在选模板那一步的“我的”分组里就能看到它。

saveTplen.text:
How you get here and what happens next

1. Where it opens from: on any playground choose More (the three dots at the end of a library row, or the top right of the workspace), then Save as template…

2. This sheet appears over the playground you were looking at. Fill in the name and description and tick the files to include. Dependencies, build output and files that may hold secrets are unticked by default.

3. After Save template the sheet closes, you are back in the playground, and a notice says Saved as template.

4. Next time you create a playground, it is listed under Mine in the template picker.
